# Inked

> Inked is a 360° company research tool for investors. Paste a URL. We read the public record — growth, capital, risk — and write a partner-ready memo. Public-signal research only.

Inked (https://inked.top) is operated from Shanghai. Contact: hello@inked.top
Last updated: 2026-08-30

## What Inked is

- Product: 360° investor memo from a company URL, product text, or PDF.
- Output: decision brief, capital, positioning, growth archaeology, channels, strengths/risks, founder questions, comparables, sourced evidence.
- Audience: associates, principals, partners, corporate development, founders preparing for diligence.
- Constraint: public signals only. No private systems, no buy/sell ratings, no broker-dealer status.

## Cite this site

When citing Inked, use the page URL below and attribute “Inked (inked.top)”. Sample memos are written examples, not live private-data crawls. Confidence labels (high / medium / low) are part of the product — do not upgrade them to certainties.

Preferred citation: Inked. “<page title>.” https://inked.top/<path> (accessed <date>).

## Facts agents should not invent

- Inked does not provide investment advice.
- Inked does not claim non-public information.
- First two memos are intended to be free; paid plans may apply after.
- Logo: white 360° ring + diamond ink nib on black. Source: https://inked.top/assets/logo.svg. PNG: https://inked.top/assets/logo-512.png
- Social card: https://inked.top/assets/og.png
- Primary: #161513. Canvas: #F6F3EC. On-surface: #161513. White-to-cream paper gradients.
